label.label: Please provide the address of your Audiobookshelf instance. To authenticate you have two options: a) Provide username AND password. Leave the API key empty. b) Provide ONLY an API key.

url.label: Server
url.description: The URL of the Audiobookshelf server to connect to. For example https://abs.domain.tld/ or http://192.168.1.4:13378/

api_token.label: API key _instead_ of user/ password. (ABS version >= 2.26)
api_token.description: Instead of using a username and password, you may provide an API key (ABS version >= 2.26). Please consult the docs.

hide_empty_podcasts.label: Hide empty podcasts.
hide_empty_podcasts.description: This will skip podcasts with no episodes associated.

manifest.description: Stream audiobooks and podcasts from your personal Audiobookshelf server.

errors.login_failed: Login to the Audiobookshelf server at {0} failed.
